verse.verse_1: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
verse.verse_2: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
verse.verse_3: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-
verse.verse_4: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
verse.verse_5: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
verse.verse_6: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
verse.verse_7: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
verse.verse_8: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
